item.title: Ford Workers Protest Henry Ford's Nazi Connections Dearborn, Michigan, April 1941
item.description:
During the historic Ford Motor Company strike in April 1941, workers and their families marched outside the Ford River Rouge plant in Dearborn, Michigan. In this remarkable photograph, two young boys carry protest signs questioning Henry Ford's connections to Nazi Germany. One reads, "Why did Ford get a Nazi medal?" referring to the Grand Cross of the German Eagle awarded to Ford by Nazi Germany on July 30, 1938. The strike was part of a long struggle for union recognition and better working conditions. In June 1941, Ford finally recognized the United Auto Workers (UAW). A powerful glimpse into American labor history, when even children joined their families on the picket lines. Original photograph: April 1941 Location: Dearborn, Michigan, USA Colorization: S. item.description: I have applied fucking EVERYWHERE even if my knee is killing me cause my health shit and starting over is expensive and my online stuff isn't cutting it like so many think. I have FINALLY GOTTEN MY FIRST RESPONSE among all my applications. I want to cry but I am at least glad there was one application that was finally responded to that let me know I didn't get the job. item.title: New Matter-Antimatter Imbalance Model
item.description: New Matter-Antimatter Imbalance Model Oktay Yürük aka Oktay74tn, science and tech content https://imgur.com/user/Oktay74tn The universe's age is estimated at 13.8 billion years. This diagram shows the phases of its evolution. One open question in physics is the matter-antimatter imbalance, known as baryon asymmetry. According to a new model, neutrinos could explain why there is so much more matter than antimatter. Neutrinos are the second most abundant particles in the universe (photons no. 1). Their upper mass limit is 8 times 10 to the minus 37 kilograms. That is less than one-millionth the mass of an electron. Neutrinos barely interact with matter. They oscillate between three different flavors (electron neutrino - muon neutrino - tau neutrino). This is the discovery image of neutrinos in a hydrogen bubble chamber. The new model is based on sterile neutrinos, hypothetical particles with right-handed chirality. According to the Standard Model, neutrinos are left-handed. Antineutrinos are right-handed with their spin pointing along the direction of travel. N3 is a hypothetical, heavier right-handed neutrino. The scale factor a is dimensionless. It describes the expansion of the universe. This diagram shows the change of energy densities as a function of the relative scale factor. The radiation dominated (RD) era was temporarily ended by the N3 dominated era. The half-life of the heavy neutrinos is relatively long. When heavy anti-matter decayed, the by-products warmed up the universe. Some of the antimatter particles were annihilated. That created the matter-antimatter imbalance. The N3 dominated era ended with the decay of the N3 neutrinos. In this artist’s impression of the Milky Way, the dark matter halo is shown in blue. Dark matter outweighs bright matter by a factor of more than five. N3 neutrinos could have imapcted dark matter production and evolution.
